name: jolly-chicken
description: A day-to-night switch that slides a sun into a moon while clouds yield to stars.
purpose: Gives appearance or quiet-hours toggles a readable scene instead of a plain thumb, still using semantic tokens.
bestFor: playful settings rows that still need a native checkbox
demo surfaces that show light and dark in one control
avoidFor: dense toolbars that need a compact switch
forms that must stay visually quiet
